dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Nam, do you like using technology in class?
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, duː juː ˈlaɪk ˈjuːzɪŋ tɛkˈnɑːlədʒi ɪn ˈklæs?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes. I love to use apps for learning English.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs. aɪ ˈlʌv tə ˈjuːz ˈæps fər ˈlɜːrnɪŋ ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: When did you start using a computer?
dialogue.reading: ˈwɛn dɪd juː ˈstɑːrt ˈjuːzɪŋ ə kəmˈpjuːtər?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I started to use one when I was eight. My parents bought a family computer.
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈstɑːrtɪd tə ˈjuːz ˈwʌn wɛn aɪ wʌz ˈeɪt. maɪ ˈpɛrənts ˈbɔːt ə ˈfæməli kəmˈpjuːtər.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: I began using computers at university. There were no computers at my school!
dialogue.reading: aɪ bɪˈɡæn ˈjuːzɪŋ kəmˈpjuːtərz ət ˌjuːnɪˈvɜːrsəti. ðɛr wɜːr ˈnoʊ kəmˈpjuːtərz ət maɪ ˈskuːl!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Really? Did you have a digital camera?
dialogue.reading: ˈriːli? dɪd juː ˈhæv ə ˈdɪdʒɪtəl ˈkæmərə?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: No, but I had an electronic dictionary. I loved it!
dialogue.reading: ˈnoʊ, bʌt aɪ ˈhæd ən ɪˌlɛkˈtrɑːnɪk ˈdɪkʃənɛri. aɪ ˈlʌvd ɪt!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Now people just use websites and apps.
dialogue.reading: ˈnaʊ ˈpiːpəl dʒʌst ˈjuːz ˈwɛbsaɪts ənd ˈæps.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: That's right. And next semester, the university is starting to use new software for homework.
dialogue.reading: ðæts ˈraɪt. ənd ˈnɛkst səˈmɛstər, ðə ˌjuːnɪˈvɜːrsəti ɪz ˈstɑːrtɪŋ tə ˈjuːz ˈnuː ˈsɔːftwɛr fər ˈhoʊmwɜːrk.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Good! I like learning new things.
dialogue.reading: ˈɡʊd! aɪ ˈlaɪk ˈlɜːrnɪŋ ˈnuː ˈθɪŋz.
